title: Zions Bank Appoints Heidi Prokop as EVP of Marketing, Communications and Community Relations
summary: Zions Bank has promoted Heidi Prokop to executive vice president of its Marketing, Communications and Community Relations division.
body_markdown:
SALT LAKE CITY, Utah; August 8, 2025 — Zions Bank has promoted Heidi Prokop to


executive vice president of its Marketing, Communications and Community Relations division.


In this role, Prokop will lead advertising, sponsorships, and internal and external communications. She will also oversee the bank’s community engagement efforts, including charitable giving, volunteer outreach, Community Reinvestment Act programs and advocacy initiatives.


Prokop joined Zions Bank in 2001, most recently serving as senior vice president and communications group manager, where she guided internal and external communications, social media, media relations and financial education outreach, and helped drive digital and traditional marketing strategies.


Prokop has been honored with the Salt Lake Chamber of Commerce’s Pathfinder Award and recognized among *Utah Business* magazine’s “40 Under 40.” She has been listed as part of Zions Bank’s “Top Women’s Banking Team” in *American Banker* magazine.


She holds a master’s degree in British and American Literature and a bachelor’s degree in English from the University of Utah. She completed the Consumer Bankers Association’s Graduate School of Retail Bank Management.


A champion of the arts and culture, Prokop serves on the Salt Lake County Zoo, Arts & Parks Tier 1 Advisory Board and the Utah Film Center’s board of directors. Her past leadership includes roles with the Utah Division of Arts and Museums, Sundance Institute, and KRCL 90.9 FM.


**About Zions Bank** Zions Bank is Utah’s oldest financial institution and is the only local bank with a statewide distribution of branches operating 93 full-service branches. Zions Bank also operates 26 branches in Idaho and Wyoming. In addition to offering a wide range of traditional banking services, Zions Bank is also a leader in small business lending. Founded in 1873, Zions Bank has been serving the communities of Utah for more than 150 years. Additional information is available at www.zionsbank.com. A division of Zions Bancorporation N.A., Member FDIC. ****
